api_call.invalidate_all()   # Forget everything

    ``api_call.memory`` exposes the internal dictionary, whose values are
    ``(result, timestamp)`` pairs. Raising ``api_call.skip(value)`` from the
    decorated function returns ``value`` without caching it, just like
    ``memoize.skip``. With no value, it returns ``None``.

    Custom
